properties.description: Hermetic tests of tools/site_counts.py, run in CI (ci.yml step "The site's counts of reflow2's own design"). Release manifests (INCLUDES) are counted apart from links. The single-file and item layouts give the same counts for the same design. A tag with no readable design is named in `skipped`. One point a week is kept, and the latest release is always kept.
properties.findings: 3 of 3 passed locally on branch site/more-than-a-record. Seen failing first: with count_design mutated to count INCLUDES in `links`, test_a_manifest_is_counted_apart failed (links 3 against 2), then passed again once restored. Against reflow2's real tags: 14 weekly points, 7,206 records and 18,045 links at v0.83.5, plus 35,421 manifest links, none skipped, in 7.8 s.
properties.name: The site's counts of reflow2's design are never inflated or quietly empty
